system_score_direction_assumption: Higher raw CrossEncoder score indicates stronger query-job relevance, based on the configured cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 model and code path; scores are not probabilities.
interpretation: Exploratory only: only five jobs were evaluated, and human relevance labels are preliminary. Correlation is sensitive to this tiny sample and must not be reported as robust system performance.
important_limitation: Generated explanations were not provided, so explanation correctness/faithfulness was not evaluated.
